cast.name: Creator
cast.description: young Indian woman with short curly hair in a coral tank top, filming by a sunny window then at a cafe, warm confident conversational female voice

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: My skin looked dull, and my sunscreen did nothing about it.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Purple sits opposite yellow, so the tint helps balance yellow-looking dullness.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: But the real test is how it blends.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: No chalkiness, no purple residue, and no white cast.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: It's made for Indian skin and feels lightweight once absorbed.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: Plus, 4% niacinamide gives me an even-looking, Instant Glow finish.

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: And SPF 50 PA+++ handles the protection. That's my Instant Glow.
